title: How David Goggins rebuilt himself: vulnerability, visualization, the cookie jar, and a new norm of suffering
summary: In this Rich Roll conversation about Can't Hurt Me, Goggins explains how he rebuilt himself from an abusive childhood, illiteracy and 300 pounds into a Navy SEAL and ultra-runner. He covers radical honesty and vulnerability, visualizing the finish and the hard moments, resetting your "new norm," taking souls, the cookie jar, journaling, and why suffering strips away artificial layers.

principles.text: Be brutally honest with yourself and go back to where you broke to fix it.
principles.quote: no one's coming back to save your ass you have to go back to where this [ __ ] start it wherever that place is for everybody and have the courage to go back there and start fixing what broke you

principles.text: Vulnerability is strength; own your story and tell the embarrassing truth.
principles.quote: the one thing that made me who I am today is being vulnerable it's breaking myself down to the absolute rock bottom and being able to tell people who I am

principles.text: Visualize the finish and the feelings at the hard points so nothing surprises you.
principles.quote: I'm able to go through the race and see I'm gonna feel at Mile 50 almost to the almost to the exact Zac feeling right so when it comes up it's no surprise

principles.text: Reset your new norm so that waking up to suffer becomes the baseline.
principles.quote: your new norm is you wake up and you suffer and I started realizing if that's my mentality this should ain't hard anymore

principles.text: Use the cookie jar: recall past hardships you survived to find strength when things get hard.
principles.quote: the cookie jar is a reminder that oh I can get through this hard time right now but you got to take a second or two to reach into the mental cookie jar

principles.text: Suffering strips away fake layers and builds calluses on the mind.
principles.quote: as you're stripping those layers away you're building calluses over top of [ __ ] in your mind that's where the growth starts to happen is when you have to force yourself to stay in it
